problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14041529/assets/a87b00f9f7908fe62542ef7bca94277f040af97b4af24698dd648c167bcd3376.png)

Describe the shaded region shown above using set-builder notation.

$$
{(x,y)\in {R}^{2}\,:\,1\,{{field-1}}\,x\,{{field-2}}\,5,\,2\,{{field-3}}\,y\,{{field-4}}\,5}
$$
worked_solution:
A point $P(x,y)$ lies *inside* the rectangle if the following conditions are satisfied:

$$
\begin{aligned}1<x<5,\,2<y<5\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that we also need to *include* the bottom edge ($y=2$).

Therefore, we change the corresponding inequality symbol to non-strict, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}1<x<5,\,2\le y<5\end{aligned}
$$

Moreover, since *every* real value in these intervals is included, $x\in R,y\in R,$ and therefore 

$$
(x,y)\in R\times R={R}^{2}.
$$

Therefore, we can write our set as follows:

$$
{(x,y)\in {R}^{2}\,:\,1<x<5,\,2\le y<5}
$$
